name: mobile-coding-agents
description: Agentic engineering toolkit for iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native and Kotlin Multiplatform teams: a deterministic core plus one expertise pack per platform

plugins.name: mobile-core
plugins.description: Cross-platform workflows (recon, safe change, migration, debugging, performance, review, design, release), two isolated agents, guard hooks and the `mobile` CLI

plugins.name: mobile-ios
plugins.description: iOS expertise pack: build and signing, UIKit and Objective-C legacy, Swift concurrency migration, persistence migrations, testing, performance, release gates

plugins.name: mobile-android
plugins.description: Android expertise pack: Gradle and AGP, Views and Java legacy, coroutines and lifecycle, Room migrations, Compose interop, testing, performance, release gates

plugins.name: mobile-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter expertise pack: toolchain and native build failures, state-management and navigation migrations, platform interop, persistence migrations, testing, performance, release gates; wires the Dart language server

plugins.name: mobile-react-native
plugins.description: React Native expertise pack: Expo and bare builds, upgrades and the New Architecture, native modules, navigation and state, storage, testing, performance, release and over-the-air updates

plugins.name: mobile-kotlin-multiplatform
plugins.description: Kotlin Multiplatform expertise pack: source sets and common code, the Swift-facing API, Gradle and Xcode integration, architecture for shared code, storage, testing
